title: Backorder Impact on Meal Plan Changes
dataSources: Amazon order records (`amazon:order`), meal-plan inventory (`mealplan:item`), and pharmacy refill events (`pharmacy:refill`).
app: Household logistics telemetry from Amazon order history, meal-plan inventory tools, and pharmacy refill portals sent to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mealplan:item
| search changed_meals=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as changed_meals by _time backorder_flag
| sort - _time
description: Tracks meal-plan changes after backorders over time and breaks it out by backorder flag.
value: This split shows whether supply hiccups are materially reshaping the plan or just causing minor substitutions.
implementation: Send meal-plan changes after backorders events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of meal-plan changes after backorders by backorder flag.
grandmaExplanation: It turns how meal-plan changes after backorders changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
